title: The Tower of Babel Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Tower of Babel Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Tower of Babel Bible crossword: the plain of Shinar, brick and slime, the confounded language. KJV clues from Genesis 11, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: The whole earth is of one language and one speech, and they journey from the east and find a plain in the land of Shinar. They have brick for stone and slime for morter, and they decide to build something with its top reaching to heaven. The Tower of Babel makes a grid of Genesis 11.
It is a short chapter and an unusually tidy puzzle, and the KJV's slime for morter is one of the answers people remember afterwards. The closing verse is the decision to build.

clues.text: Plain in the land where they dwelt
The LORD did there confound theirs
Name of the city, so called for the confusion

verseText: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
